steps.title: Log into VIROME
steps.instruction: Access the VIROME web application and authenticate.

substeps.instruction: Click the **Login** button.
Enter your username and password.
Click the **Compare** button to proceed to the Comparinator.

steps.title: Select libraries for comparison
steps.instruction: Choose the private or public libraries you wish to analyze.

substeps.instruction: The VIROME Comparinator displays a list of both private and public libraries.
Use the dialogue box below the list to filter libraries by a search term if needed.
Double‑click the desired library names; they will appear in the panel to the right of the list.

steps.title: Choose metrics and output formats
steps.instruction: Specify which comparison metrics and file formats to generate.

substeps.instruction: Select one or more metrics (Taxonomy, Function, Environment).
Select output format(s):
• Tab‑delimited file
• Biological Observation Matrix (BIOM) format for QIIME analysis.

steps.title: Submit comparison and download results
steps.instruction: Run the comparison and retrieve the generated files.

substeps.instruction: Click **Submit**.
When prompted, click **OK** to download the data; do **not** change the suggested file name.
One file will be created for each metric you selected.
Tab‑delimited files can be opened in Excel if desired.

steps.title: Retrieve data via VIROME wizard
steps.instruction: Complete the download wizard to finalize file acquisition.

substeps.instruction: Click **Get Data**.
Click **Next**.
Click **Next** again.
Click **Finish**.
Click **OK** to close the dialog.

steps.title: Run QIIME summarize script
steps.instruction: Generate taxonomic summary plots using QIIME.

substeps.instruction: Open a QIIME terminal window (MacQIIME used in this example).
Run the script **summarize_taxa_through_plots.py** with the following arguments:
‑i taxonomy.normalized.biom   (input BIOM file)
‑o CB454tax_summ               (output prefix)
‑m mapping.txt                (mapping file)
Full command:
summarize_taxa_through_plots.py -i taxonomy.normalized.biom -o CB454tax_summ -m mapping.txt

steps.title: View generated bar plots
steps.instruction: Open the QIIME output graphics to inspect taxonomic composition.

substeps.instruction: QIIME creates stacked bar‑plot HTML files based on the VIROME taxonomic data.
Open these bar‑chart files with a web browser.

steps.title: Explore additional QIIME analyses
steps.instruction: Access QIIME resources for further diversity analyses.

substeps.instruction: In the VIROME Comparinator, click the QIIME logo (or go to http://qiime.org/).
From the QIIME homepage you can run rarefaction curves, alpha‑diversity pipelines, or beta‑diversity PCA using the King viewer.
